mentions.description: A weekly newsletter that keeps readers fully informed about agentic coding in a single weekly email. It focuses narrowly on what engineers and tech leaders would find useful for shipping code and leading teams, filtering out generic AI news, executive commentary, and marketing fluff.
mentions.problem: Staying up to date on agentic coding is hard because most coverage mixes in generic AI news and marketing fluff.
